data.body: RP-03 fuse calibration checkpoint: absolute total-failure cap rejected as too eager for large batches. Pending recommendation uses 3 consecutive exhausted logical outcomes or 5 failures in the latest 10 eligible outcomes; endpoint-family inference requires 2 tickets, provider inference requires 2 tickets plus 2 endpoint families. Success resets consecutive state but remains rolling-window evidence; immediate authoritative scopes are unchanged. Full rationale and prior art are in .joe-janitor/rp03-jira-failure-taxonomy.md and rubellite-secondary-cub. RP-04 untouched.
